nodes.languageNotes: Uses an Arquillian BOM and a cargo-maven2-plugin setup so `mvn package cargo:run` starts the app on Payara.

nodes.name: beans.xml
nodes.summary: CDI 1.1 descriptor enabling bean discovery mode 'all' so every class in the web archive is a managed bean.

nodes.name: glassfish-web.xml
nodes.summary: GlassFish-specific deployment descriptor setting the /cargo-tracker context root, class loader delegation, JSP options and UTF-8 parameter encoding.

nodes.name: web.xml

nodes.languageNotes: Uses Maven-filtered placeholders such as ${webapp.databaseTempDir} and java:app JNDI names for app-scoped resources.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to see what Cargo Tracker is: a Jakarta EE sample of domain-driven design for cargo shipping.

tour.title: Domain Model: Cargo Aggregate
tour.description: The core aggregate: Cargo with its tracking id, route specification, itinerary and delivery progress.

tour.title: Domain Model: Handling, Voyage, Location
tour.description: Handling events record what happens to cargo; voyages and locations describe the transport network.

tour.title: Repositories and Domain Services
tour.description: Repository interfaces and the routing service abstract persistence and routing from the domain.

tour.title: Application Services
tour.description: Application services orchestrate use cases: booking, handling events and inspection.

tour.title: Infrastructure: Persistence and Routing
tour.description: JPA repositories implement persistence; ExternalRoutingService calls the pathfinder.

tour.title: Infrastructure: Messaging
tour.description: JMS-based events decouple handling, delivery and misdirection processing.

tour.title: Booking Interface
tour.description: Facade, assemblers and JSF backing beans serve the booking UI.

tour.title: Tracking and Handling Interfaces
tour.description: Public tracking page, and handling inputs via REST, mobile and file batch.

tour.title: Pathfinder Service
tour.description: A separate routing service computes candidate itineraries over a graph.

tour.title: Configuration
tour.description: Deployment descriptors and CDI/JSF configuration wire the app together.
